sn22.25:1.2: “Bhikkhus, abandon desire and lust for form.
sn22.25:1.3: Thus that form will be abandoned, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated so that it is no more subject to future arising.
sn22.25:1.11: Thus that consciousness will be abandoned, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated so that it is no more subject to future arising.”
